ns0:g.ns0:text: D03 Which uncertainty configurations are actually recorded?

ns0:text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Exact intersection analysis of 10 non-review records and 7 mechanisms; 9 distinct positive-code configurations.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Each column is an observed exact set, not an architecture proposed by the reviewer. Each paper enters exactly one column.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Filled circles indicate R-coded methods. Grey circles mean no positive R code; conceptual support and unrecorded features remain distinct in the source CSV.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Top bars sum to ten records. Three-digit labels identify sources (DTUM prefix omitted). Similar code sets do not establish identical implementations.
